Chicken Caesar Power Salad

A giant, crunchy romaine salad tossed with juicy chicken and a tangy Greek-yogurt Caesar dressing.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
15 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
11

Ingredients

  • ½ cup (115 g) plain fat-free Greek yogurt
  • ¼ cup (30 g) grated parmesan
  • 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice
  • 1 tbsp minced garlic
  • 1 tbsp (15 ml) Worcestershire sauce
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp anchovy paste (optional) (optional)
  • 1 tsp Dijon mustard
  • ½ tsp salt and black pepper
  • 6 cups (255 g) chopped romaine
  • 8 oz (225 g) cooked chicken breast, sliced
  • ¼ cup (15 g) croutons

Amounts are scaled from 1 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Add Greek yogurt, parmesan, lemon juice, garlic, Worcestershire, olive oil, optional anchovy paste, Dijon, salt and pepper to a blender or food processor. Blend smooth.
  2. If the dressing is too thick, thin with skim milk, 1 tbsp at a time.
  3. Put romaine and cooked chicken in a large bowl. Pour over the dressing and toss until evenly coated.
  4. Top with croutons and a little extra parmesan, if you like. Eat right away for the crunchiest salad.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
